from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,resource,subprocess,sys,time,uuid
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
from run_lambdapi import checker_identity,execution_settings,retain_inputs,classify_exit,tooling_inputs
from check_registry import input_hashes
root=Path.cwd();pkg=(root/'tmp/probes/checker_boundary_review/package').resolve()
binaries={'stock':Path('/home/user1/.opam/default/bin/lambdapi'),'isolated':root/'tmp/probes/checker_rollback_memory/source/_build/default/src/cli/lambdapi.exe'}
cases={'two_file_restore':(['guard_first.lp','guard_second.lp'],0),'single_file_sensitivity':(['guard_joined.lp'],1),'multiple_file_sr_rejection':(['guard_bad_sr.lp','guard_second.lp'],1)}
records={}
for label,binary in binaries.items():
 for case,(names,expected) in cases.items():
  env=dict(os.environ,EMDASH_LP_TIMEOUT='90s',EMDASH_LP_MEMORY_MIB='2048',EMDASH_LAMBDAPI_WARNINGS='1',OCAMLRUNPARAM='o=20,v=1024')
  settings=execution_settings(Path('tmp/checker_boundary_review.lp'),env)
  inputs=input_hashes([Path(n) for n in names],pkg,objects=True);assert not any(n.endswith('.lpo') for n in inputs)
  retain_inputs(inputs,pkg)
  run_id=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
  log=root/'logs/check-runs'/(run_id+'.log')
  command=['bash',str(root/'scripts/lambdapi_resource_guard.sh'),str(binary),'check','--no-colors',*names]
  start=time.monotonic()
  with log.open('w') as out:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=pkg,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  wall=time.monotonic()-start;output=log.read_text()
  assert inputs==input_hashes([Path(n) for n in names],pkg,objects=True)
  rec={'schema':'emdash-checker-boundary-review-v1','id':run_id,'case':case,'binaryLabel':label,'checker':checker_identity(binary),'command':command,'settings':settings,'inputs':inputs,'runnerInputs':tooling_inputs(),'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'logSha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'wallSeconds':wall,'checkerExit':r.returncode,'outcome':classify_exit(r.returncode,wall,settings,output),'expectedExitClass':expected,'sourceOnly':True}
  (root/'logs/check-runs'/(run_id+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rec,indent=2)+'\n')
  assert (r.returncode!=0)==bool(expected),(label,case,output)
  if case=='single_file_sensitivity':assert 'Assertion failed' in output,output
  if case=='multiple_file_sr_rejection':assert ('Unable to prove type preservation' in output or 'does not preserve typing' in output),output
  records[label+'/'+case]=rec
  print(label,case,rec['outcome'],flush=True)
(root/'tmp/probes/checker_boundary_review/cli_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
